summary: Enviri Corp filed an 8-K on May 20, 2026, announcing updates on its spin-off of Harsco Environmental and Harsco Rail into a new publicly traded company (New Enviri) and the sale of Clean Earth to Veolia. The spin-off and sale are expected to close June 1, 2026. Enviri stockholders will receive $15.00 per share at closing and one share of New Enviri for every three Enviri shares. When-issued trading for New Enviri begins May 27 under symbol NVRI WI. The Clean Earth sale was approved by stockholders on May 4, 2026. Watch for closing conditions and post-spin trading dynamics.
